title: payments.v1.PaymentFailed
description: An authorization or capture attempt did not succeed. `payment_id` is present even for a failed authorization: payments allocates the id and records the attempt before calling the PSP, so that a retry with the same idempotency key resolves to the same record rather than creating a second one. `retryable` tells the caller whether backing off could ever help.

operation.description: Which operation failed. A failed VOID or REFUND is a compensation failure and requires operator attention; it is the one case this system cannot resolve automatically.

retryable.description: True when the same request could succeed later (PSP_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR). False for terminal declines. Derived from failure_code and published explicitly so consumers do not have to keep their own copy of that mapping.

detail.description: Operator-facing text. Never contains a card number, name or any PSP token.
